text:
The era of 'send everything to the cloud' for AI is officially over.

Google has just made **Gemini Nano** available directly on Android devices for on-device summarization. This is a massive win for mobile developers because it shifts intelligence from the server to the user's phone.

Here is why this matters:
• **Privacy First:** Since the processing happens locally, sensitive user data never leaves the device.
• **Instant Speed:** There is no network latency. The AI responds in real-time.
• **Lower Costs:** You don't pay for API calls for every single interaction in the app.

We are moving toward a future where apps are smarter, faster, and more private. The ability to run these models on-device is the key to the next generation of mobile UX.

What kind of app feature would you build if you knew the AI was running entirely on the user's device?

#Android #MobileDev #AI #GeminiNano #OnDeviceAI
